  •  Slightly increases range

  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds

Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.desc: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.desc:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.desc: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Cast No Shadows
perks.desc: Dealing melee damage increases this weapon's handling and loads a small amount of ammo from reserves.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 115 from 6 September 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6axWXT6NCn4jZVuRkCTfiu?si=72aafbad8138409a) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add clearing minor enemies in end-game content. Breachlight is back, this time as a Strand version of the heavy burst sidearm. Its stats are decent at base - 48 Range equates to 15.50m while ADS, 35 Handling is 0.33s ready, 0.27s ADS speed and 0.36s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 23 is a 1.87s reload. The range is pretty compressed on sidearms, so you'll probably feel the most benefit with barrel perks that boost handling, and then look to boost your magazine size, preferably while not harming reload too much with the mag perk. Desperate Measures is a really strong second trait column damage perk, providing up to a ×1.3 boost for Guardians that actively use their abilities, and is very easy to proc while transcendent. To pair with that, in the first column, Demolitionist and Pugilist look like natural partners, or if gunfeel is more important to you Threat Detector should be proccing constantly. The Cast No Shadows origin trait is great for topping off roughly 20% of your magazine and boosting handling for a short time on dealing melee damage. If you're interested, a Speleologist is someone involved in the scientific study or exploration of caves. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Breachlight returns to us. One of the crowd favorites. Arrowhead Brake cleans up the recoil nicely. Demolitionist and Desperate Measures compliment one another nicely (though Adrenaline Junkie is the peanut butter to the jelly; Desperate Measures just works with more abilities). Vorpal Weapon gives you some flexibility against majors or champions. Slice and Hatchling are best used when on your Strand subclass." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Over in PvP Heavy Burst sidearms are a bit of a mixed bag. Perpetual Motion adds much needed stability by moving around, and unfortunately without a great kill perk in the fourth column we have Swashbuckler for melee builds, Adrenaline Junkie for grenade builds and Desperate Measures for any build." Recommended MW: Range.
